title: StringNamespaceId
description: Browser-specific. Schema representing a string namespace.

oneOf.title: StringNamespaceDefault
oneOf.description: The default string namespace, used for uncategorized strings. Strings added by an AddStringChange are added to this string namespace.

oneOf.title: StringNamespaceNodeName
oneOf.description: A string namespace containing DOM node names (e.g. 'div', '#text').

oneOf.title: StringNamespaceAttributeName
oneOf.description: A string namespace containing DOM attribute names.

oneOf.title: StringNamespaceAttributeValue
oneOf.description: A string namespace containing DOM attribute values.

oneOf.title: StringNamespaceTextContent
oneOf.description: A string namespace containing DOM text content.

oneOf.title: StringNamespaceFormInput
oneOf.description: A string namespace containing DOM form input values.

oneOf.title: StringNamespaceCSS
oneOf.description: A string namespace containing CSS inline styles and stylesheets.
